title: Effect of amendment.
bodyText: The amendments provided in section 51-2 shall not be construed to amend or affect any other provision of the franchise referred to in section 51-2.
bodyHtml: §51-3  Effect of amendment.  The amendments provided in section 51-2 shall not be construed to amend or affect any other provision of the franchise referred to in section 51-2. [L 1967, c 300, §3; HRS §51-3]
